snippet.title: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator announcement trailer for this upcoming cozy fantasy simulator game. Learn about your objective, check out gameplay, and more in this trailer. Become a Master Blacksmith in Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op. Fantasy Blacksmight Simulator will be available on PC. You can join the playtest on Steam if you're interested.
